row.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION record_palre_compatibility_evaluation(p_prescription_id uuid, p_design_family text, p_result_status text, p_preferred_index numeric, p_measurements jsonb, p_candidates jsonb) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ declare v_org_id uuid := current_org(); v_user_id uuid := auth.uid(); v_run_id uuid; v_candidate jsonb; v_position integer:=0; v_eligible boolean; v_match_type text; begin if v_org_id is null or v_user_id is null then raise exception 'Authenticated organisation context is required'; end if; if p_design_family not in ('SV','BF','PROG','OCC') or p_result_status not in ('exact_match','nearest_eligible_match','no_eligible_match') or jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_candidates,'[]'::jsonb))<>'array' or jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_measurements,'{}'::jsonb))<>'object' or jsonb_array_length(coalesce(p_candidates,'[]'::jsonb))>250 then raise exception 'Invalid PALRE evaluation payload'; end if; if not exists(select 1 from profiles p where p.id=v_user_id and p.org_id=v_org_id and p.is_approved=true and p.deactivated=false and p.role_key='optometrist') then raise exception 'Only an approved optometrist can record PALRE evaluations'; end if; if not exists(select 1 from prescriptions rx where rx.id=p_prescription_id and rx.org_id=v_org_id and rx.status='active') then raise exception 'Active prescription does not belong to current organisation'; end if; insert into lens_compatibility_evaluation_runs(org_id,prescription_id,design_family,result_status,preferred_index,measurements,evaluated_by) values(v_org_id,p_prescription_id,p_design_family,p_result_status,p_preferred_index,coalesce(p_measurements,'{}'::jsonb),v_user_id) returning id into v_run_id; for v_candidate in select value from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_candidates,'[]'::jsonb)) with ordinality x(value,ord) order by ord loop v_position:=v_position+1; v_eligible:=coalesce((v_candidate->>'eligible')::boolean,false); v_match_type:=case when v_eligible then coalesce(v_candidate->>'match_type','nearest_eligible') else 'ineligible' end; insert into lens_compatibility_evaluation_candidates( org_id,evaluation_run_id,lens_package_id,manufacturer_sku_snapshot,candidate_position,eligible,match_type, matched_rule_id,matched_option_combination_id,preference_score,od_result,os_result,reason_details ) values(v_org_id,v_run_id,(v_candidate->>'package_id')::uuid,nullif(v_candidate->>'manufacturer_sku',''), v_position,v_eligible,v_match_type,nullif(v_candidate->>'matched_rule_id','')::uuid, nullif(v_candidate->>'matched_option_combination_id','')::uuid,nullif(v_candidate->>'preference_score','')::numeric, coalesce(v_candidate->'od_result','{}'::jsonb),coalesce(v_candidate->'os_result','{}'::jsonb),coalesce(v_candidate->'reason_details','[]'::jsonb)); end loop; if p_result_status='no_eligible_match' and exists(select 1 from lens_compatibility_evaluation_candidates where org_id=v_org_id and evaluation_run_id=v_run_id and eligible) then raise exception 'No-match run cannot contain eligible candidates'; end if; if p_result_status='exact_match' and not exists(select 1 from lens_compatibility_evaluation_candidates where org_id=v_org_id and evaluation_run_id=v_run_id and eligible and match_type='exact') then raise exception 'Exact-match run must contain an exact eligible candidate'; end if; if p_result_status='nearest_eligible_match' and (not exists(select 1 from lens_compatibility_evaluation_candidates where org_id=v_org_id and evaluation_run_id=v_run_id and eligible and match_type='nearest_eligible') or exists(select 1 from lens_compatibility_evaluation_candidates where org_id=v_org_id and evaluation_run_id=v_run_id and eligible and match_type='exact')) then raise exception 'Nearest-match run must contain eligible nearest candidates and no exact candidate'; end if; return v_run_id; end $function$

row.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION record_palre_recommendation_run(p_prescription_id uuid, p_compatibility_run_ids uuid[], p_status text, p_snapshot jsonb, p_candidates jsonb) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp' AS $function$ declare v_org uuid:=current_org(); v_user uuid:=auth.uid(); v_run uuid; v_item jsonb; v_pos integer:=0; v_package uuid; v_match text; begin if v_org is null or v_user is null then raise exception 'Authenticated organisation required'; end if; if p_status not in ('awaiting_optometrist_review','no_eligible_match') or jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_snapshot,'{}'::jsonb))<>'object' or jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_candidates,'[]'::jsonb))<>'array' or jsonb_array_length(coalesce(p_candidates,'[]'::jsonb))>250 then raise exception 'Invalid recommendation run payload'; end if; if not exists(select 1 from profiles p where p.id=v_user and p.org_id=v_org and p.is_approved and not p.deactivated and p.role_key='optometrist') then raise exception 'Only approved optometrists can create recommendation runs'; end if; if not exists(select 1 from prescriptions rx where rx.id=p_prescription_id and rx.org_id=v_org and rx.status='active') then raise exception 'Active prescription not found in current organisation'; end if; if coalesce(array_length(p_compatibility_run_ids,1),0)=0 or exists( select 1 from unnest(p_compatibility_run_ids) x(id) where not exists(select 1 from lens_compatibility_evaluation_runs r where r.id=x.id and r.org_id=v_org and r.prescription_id=p_prescription_id) ) then raise exception 'Compatibility evaluation references are invalid'; end if; if p_status='no_eligible_match' and jsonb_array_length(coalesce(p_candidates,'[]'::jsonb))<>0 then raise exception 'No-match recommendation cannot contain candidates'; end if; if p_status='awaiting_optometrist_review' and jsonb_array_length(coalesce(p_candidates,'[]'::jsonb))=0 then raise exception 'Review queue recommendation requires at least one eligible candidate'; end if; insert into palre_recommendation_runs(org_id,prescription_id,status,compatibility_run_ids,recommendation_snapshot,created_by) values(v_org,p_prescription_id,p_status,coalesce(p_compatibility_run_ids,'{}'),coalesce(p_snapshot,'{}'::jsonb),v_user) returning id into v_run; for v_item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(p_candidates,'[]'::jsonb)) with ordinality x(value,ord) order by ord loop v_pos:=v_pos+1; v_package:=(v_item->>'package_id')::uuid; v_match:=v_item->>'match_type'; if v_match not in ('exact','nearest_eligible') then raise exception 'Recommendation candidate must be clinically eligible'; end if; if not exists(select 1 from lens_compatibility_evaluation_candidates c where c.org_id=v_org and c.lens_package_id=v_package and c.eligible and c.match_type=v_match and c.evaluation_run_id=any(p_compatibility_run_ids) and exists(select 1 from lens_compatibility_evaluation_runs r where r.org_id=v_org and r.id=c.evaluation_run_id and r.design_family=v_item->>'design_family')) then raise exception 'Candidate is not eligible in the referenced compatibility run'; end if; insert into palre_recommendation_candidates(org_id,recommendation_run_id,lens_package_id,candidate_position,tier,match_type,candidate_snapshot) values(v_org,v_run,v_package,v_pos,nullif(v_item->>'tier',''),v_match,coalesce(v_item->'snapshot','{}'::jsonb)); end loop; insert into palre_recommendation_events(org_id,recommendation_run_id,event_type,actor_id,event_payload) values(v_org,v_run,case when p_status='awaiting_optometrist_review' then 'recommendation_prepared_for_optometrist_review' else 'no_eligible_match' end,v_user, jsonb_build_object('candidate_count',v_pos,'compatibility_run_ids',p_compatibility_run_ids)); return v_run; end $function$

row.name: approve_stock_audit
row.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION approve_stock_audit(p_session uuid) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare s stock_audit_sessions%rowtype; l record; v_delta integer; v_current integer; begin if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'Authentication required' using errcode = '42501'; end if; select * into s from stock_audit_sessions where id = p_session for update; if not found or s.org_id <> current_org() or not can_access_branch(s.branch_id) then raise exception 'Stock audit not found' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if not (is_manager() and has_perm('stock_audit')) then raise exception 'Only an authorised manager can approve a stock audit' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if s.started_by = auth.uid() then raise exception 'The person who started a count cannot approve it' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if s.status <> 'submitted' then raise exception 'Only submitted stock counts can be approved'; end if; if exists (select 1 from stock_audit_lines where session_id = p_session and counted_qty is null) then raise exception 'Every line must have a counted quantity'; end if; for l in select * from stock_audit_lines where session_id = p_session loop insert into stock(org_id,branch_id,product_id,qty) values(s.org_id,s.branch_id,l.product_id,0) on conflict(branch_id,product_id) do nothing; select qty into v_current from stock where org_id=s.org_id and branch_id=s.branch_id and product_id=l.product_id for update; v_delta := l.counted_qty - v_current; if v_delta = 0 then continue; end if; insert into stock_movements(org_id, branch_id, product_id, delta, reason, note, created_by) values (s.org_id, s.branch_id, l.product_id, v_delta, 'audit', 'Cycle count ' || left(s.id::text, 8) || '; snapshot variance ' || (l.counted_qty-l.expected_qty), auth.uid()); end loop; update stock_audit_sessions set status = 'approved', approved_by = auth.uid(), approved_at = now() where id = p_session; insert into audit_log(org_id, user_id, table_name, row_id, action, new_data) values (s.org_id, auth.uid(), 'stock_audit_sessions', p_session, 'APPROVE', jsonb_build_object('branch_id',s.branch_id,'line_count',(select count(*) from stock_audit_lines where session_id=p_session))); end $function$

row.name: enforce_branch_limit
row.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION enforce_branch_limit() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_max int; v_cur int; begin if tg_op = 'INSERT' or (tg_op = 'UPDATE' and new.is_active and not coalesce(old.is_active,false)) then select max_branches into v_max from billing_plans bp join org_subscriptions s on s.plan_id = bp.id where s.org_id = new.org_id order by s.created_at desc limit 1; if v_max is not null then select count(*) into v_cur from branches where org_id = new.org_id and is_active and (tg_op = 'UPDATE' or id is distinct from new.id); -- v_cur never contains the row being written (it is not active yet on -- INSERT, and is excluded by is_active while still inactive on UPDATE), so -- the row under test must be counted explicitly or a max_branches=1 plan -- silently admits a second branch. if (v_cur + (case when tg_op = 'INSERT' or (tg_op = 'UPDATE' and new.is_active) then 1 else 0 end)) > v_max then if coalesce(entitlement_enforcement(), 'log') = 'enforce' then raise exception 'Branch limit reached for your subscription plan. Upgrade to add more branches.' using errcode = '42501'; end if; perform entitlement_log_only(new.org_id, tg_table_name, new.id, jsonb_build_object( 'limit', 'branches', 'max', v_max, 'current', v_cur, 'op', tg_op)); end if; end if; end if; return new; end $function$

Upgrade to invite more staff.' using errcode = '42501'; end if; perform entitlement_log_only(new.org_id, tg_table_name, new.id, jsonb_build_object( 'limit', 'employees', 'max', v_max, 'current', v_cur, 'op', tg_op)); end if; end if; end if; return new; end $function$

row.name: guard_stock_audit_line
row.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION guard_stock_audit_line() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare s stock_audit_sessions%rowtype; begin select * into s from stock_audit_sessions where id = coalesce(new.session_id, old.session_id) for update; if not found or s.status <> 'counting' or s.org_id <> current_org() or not can_access_branch(s.branch_id) then raise exception 'Stock count is locked or not accessible' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if tg_op = 'INSERT' then if not exists (select 1 from products p where p.id = new.product_id and p.org_id = s.org_id and p.status = 'active') then raise exception 'Product is not active in this organisation'; end if; select qty into new.expected_qty from stock where org_id=s.org_id and branch_id=s.branch_id and product_id=new.product_id; new.expected_qty := coalesce(new.expected_qty,0); new.org_id := s.org_id; elsif tg_op = 'UPDATE' then if new.session_id <> old.session_id or new.product_id <> old.product_id or new.expected_qty <> old.expected_qty then raise exception 'Count line identity and expected quantity are immutable'; end if; new.org_id := old.org_id; new.counted_by := auth.uid(); new.counted_at := now(); end if; return coalesce(new, old); end $function$

row.name: guard_stock_audit_session
row.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION guard_stock_audit_session() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ begin if tg_op = 'INSERT' then if auth.uid() is null or new.org_id <> current_org() or new.started_by <> auth.uid() or new.status <> 'counting' or new.submitted_at is not null or new.approved_by is not null or new.approved_at is not null or not has_perm('stock_audit') or not can_access_branch(new.branch_id) then raise exception 'Invalid or unauthorised stock audit session' using errcode='42501'; end if; return new; end if; if tg_op = 'UPDATE' then if new.id is distinct from old.id or new.org_id is distinct from old.org_id or new.branch_id is distinct from old.branch_id or new.title is distinct from old.title or new.brand_id is distinct from old.brand_id or new.shelf_location is distinct from old.shelf_location or new.started_by is distinct from old.started_by or new.created_at is distinct from old.created_at then raise exception 'Stock audit identity and scope are immutable'; end if; if old.status = 'counting' and new.status = 'submitted' then if auth.uid() <> old.started_by or not has_perm('stock_audit') or exists (select 1 from stock_audit_lines where session_id=old.id and counted_qty is null) then raise exception 'Every line must be counted by the session owner before submission' using errcode='42501'; end if; new.submitted_at := now(); new.approved_by := null; new.approved_at := null; elsif old.status = 'submitted' and new.status = 'approved' then if auth.uid() is null or auth.uid() = old.started_by or not is_manager() or not has_perm('stock_audit') or new.approved_by is distinct from auth.uid() then raise exception 'Only another authorised manager can approve this stock count' using errcode='42501'; end if; new.approved_at := now(); else raise exception 'Invalid stock audit state transition'; end if; return new; end if; raise exception 'Stock audit sessions cannot be deleted'; end $function$

row.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION refresh_subscription_usage() RETURNS integer LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_total integer := 0; o record; begin -- The scheduler carries no tenant identity. Clear any residual JWT claims -- (set_config(..., true) is transaction-scoped, so a session can outlive the -- reset role that follows it) so the per-org guard sees a cron/service caller -- instead of a stale authenticated member of some other company. perform set_config('request.jwt.claims', '', true); perform set_config('request.jwt.claim.sub', '', true); for o in select id from organizations loop v_total := v_total + refresh_subscription_usage(o.id); end loop; return v_total; end $function$

Service-role callers -- (cron, platform admin client) have no auth.uid() and pass this guard. if auth.uid() is not null and not exists (select 1 from profiles pr where pr.id = auth.uid() and pr.org_id = p_org) and not exists (select 1 from platform_users pu where pu.user_id = auth.uid() and pu.is_active) then raise exception 'refresh_subscription_usage: organisation mismatch'; end if; for r in select metric, value from org_usage(p_org) loop insert into subscription_usage (org_id, metric, value, period_start, period_end, updated_at) values (p_org, r.metric, r.value, v_period, v_period + interval '1 month', now()) on conflict (org_id, metric, period_start) do update set value = excluded.value, updated_at = now(); v_rows := v_rows + 1; end loop; return v_rows; end $function$

row.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION resolve_entitlements(p_org uuid) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_sub record; v_plan record; v_status text; v_features jsonb := '{}'::jsonb; v_limits jsonb := '{}'::jsonb; begin select * into v_sub from org_subscriptions where org_id = p_org order by created_at desc limit 1; if v_sub is null then -- No subscription: minimal read-only entitlements return jsonb_build_object('status','none','features',jsonb_build_object(),'limits',jsonb_build_object('branches',1,'employees',3,'customers',100,'storage_mb',100)); end if; v_status := v_sub.status; -- grace window handling if v_status = 'past_due' and v_sub.grace_ends_at is not null and v_sub.grace_ends_at > now() then v_status := 'grace'; end if; select * into v_plan from billing_plans where id = v_sub.plan_id; if v_plan is null then return jsonb_build_object('status', v_status, 'features', jsonb_build_object(), 'limits', jsonb_build_object()); end if; v_features := coalesce(v_plan.features, '{}'::jsonb); v_limits := jsonb_build_object( 'branches', v_plan.max_branches, 'employees', v_plan.max_employees, 'customers', v_plan.max_customers, 'storage_mb', v_plan.storage_mb ); -- Expired/suspended block writes immediately. Cancelled only blocks once the -- period it already paid for has ended (the daily lifecycle job then moves -- the row to 'expired', so the blocked state never dangles on 'cancelled'). if v_status in ('expired','suspended') or (v_status = 'cancelled' and (v_sub.current_period_end is null or v_sub.current_period_end <= now())) then v_features := v_features || jsonb_build_object('_writes_blocked', true); end if; return jsonb_build_object( 'status', v_status, 'plan_code', v_plan.code, 'plan_name', v_plan.name, 'trial_ends_at', v_sub.trial_ends_at, 'grace_ends_at', v_sub.grace_ends_at, 'current_period_end', v_sub.current_period_end, 'features', v_features, 'limits', v_limits ); end $function$

row.name: run_subscription_lifecycle
row.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION run_subscription_lifecycle() RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_trial_expired int := 0; v_past_due int := 0; v_grace_expired int := 0; v_cancelled int := 0; n int; begin -- 1. Trial ran out. New signups always get a trial (20261203000000), so this is -- the transition that turns an abandoned signup into an expired tenant. with due as ( update org_subscriptions set status = 'expired', updated_at = now() where status = 'trialing' and trial_ends_at is not null and trial_ends_at <= now() returning id, org_id, trial_ends_at ) insert into subscription_events (org_id, event_type, payload) select org_id, 'subscription.trial_expired', jsonb_build_object('subscription_id', id, 'trial_ends_at', trial_ends_at) from due; get diagnostics n = row_count; v_trial_expired := n; -- 2. Paid period ended and auto-renew did not land -> grace window, not a hard stop. -- grace_days comes from the plan (default 7) so the platform sets the policy. update org_subscriptions s set status = 'past_due', grace_ends_at = now() + make_interval(days => coalesce(p.grace_days, 7)), updated_at = now() from billing_plans p where s.plan_id = p.id and s.status in ('active', 'payment_pending') and s.current_period_end is not null and s.current_period_end <= now() and (s.grace_ends_at is null or s.grace_ends_at <= now()); get diagnostics n = row_count; v_past_due := n; -- Same transition for a subscription with no plan attached: fall back to 7 days. update org_subscriptions set status = 'past_due', grace_ends_at = now() + make_interval(days => 7), updated_at = now() where plan_id is null and status in ('active', 'payment_pending') and current_period_end is not null and current_period_end <= now() and (grace_ends_at is null or grace_ends_at <= now()); get diagnostics n = row_count; v_past_due := v_past_due + n; -- 3. Grace window over -> expired. Writes stop, everything else stays reachable. with due as ( update org_subscriptions set status = 'expired', grace_ends_at = null, updated_at = now() where status = 'past_due' and grace_ends_at is not null and grace_ends_at <= now() returning id, org_id, grace_ends_at ) insert into subscription_events (org_id, event_type, payload) select org_id, 'subscription.expired', jsonb_build_object('subscription_id', id, 'grace_ended_at', grace_ends_at) from due; get diagnostics n = row_count; v_grace_expired := n; -- 4. Cancelled at the end of the period it already paid for. with due as ( update org_subscriptions set status = 'expired', updated_at = now() where status = 'cancelled' and current_period_end is not null and current_period_end <= now() returning id, org_id, current_period_end ) insert into subscription_events (org_id, event_type, payload) select org_id, 'subscription.expired', jsonb_build_object('subscription_id', id, 'period_end', current_period_end) from due; get diagnostics n = row_count; v_cancelled := n; return jsonb_build_object( 'ok', true, 'trial_expired', v_trial_expired, 'moved_to_past_due', v_past_due, 'grace_expired', v_grace_expired, 'cancelled_expired', v_cancelled); end $function$

v_customer uuid; v_appt uuid; v_branch uuid; v_rx uuid; v_exam uuid; v_row eye_examinations%rowtype; v_valid date; begin if v_org is null or v_user is null then raise exception 'Authentication required' using errcode='42501'; end if; v_customer := (p_data->>'customer_id')::uuid; v_appt := nullif(p_data->>'appointment_id','')::uuid; if not exists(select 1 from customers where id=v_customer and org_id=v_org) then raise exception 'Customer not found' using errcode='42501'; end if; if v_appt is not null then select branch_id into v_branch from appointments where id=v_appt and org_id=v_org and customer_id=v_customer; if not found then raise exception 'Appointment not found for this customer'; end if; else v_branch := nullif(p_data->>'branch_id','')::uuid; end if; if v_branch is null or not can_access_branch(v_branch) then raise exception 'No access to examination branch' using errcode='42501'; end if; if nullif(p_data->>'od_sph','') is not null or nullif(p_data->>'os_sph','') is not null then v_valid := current_date + make_interval(months => greatest(1,least(60,coalesce(nullif(p_data->>'next_review_months','')::int,24)))); insert into prescriptions(org_id,branch_id,customer_id,rx_type,od_sph,od_cyl,od_axis,od_add,os_sph,os_cyl,os_axis,os_add,pd_far,pd_near,rx_date,valid_till,examined_by,remarks) values(v_org,v_branch,v_customer,coalesce(nullif(p_data->>'rx_type',''),'single_vision'),nullif(p_data->>'od_sph','')::numeric,nullif(p_data->>'od_cyl','')::numeric,nullif(p_data->>'od_axis','')::int,nullif(p_data->>'od_add','')::numeric,nullif(p_data->>'os_sph','')::numeric,nullif(p_data->>'os_cyl','')::numeric,nullif(p_data->>'os_axis','')::int,nullif(p_data->>'os_add','')::numeric,nullif(p_data->>'pd_far','')::numeric,nullif(p_data->>'pd_near','')::numeric,now(),v_valid,coalesce(nullif(p_data->>'examiner_name',''),'Staff'),p_data->>'notes') returning id into v_rx; end if; select jsonb_populate_record(null::eye_examinations, p_data || jsonb_build_object('id',gen_random_uuid(),'org_id',v_org,'branch_id',v_branch,'prescription_id',v_rx,'created_at',now(),'updated_at',now())) into v_row; insert into eye_examinations select v_row.* returning id into v_exam; if v_appt is not null then update appointments set status='completed',updated_at=now() where id=v_appt and org_id=v_org; end if; return v_exam; end $function$

row.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION set_branch_active(p_branch uuid, p_active boolean) RETURNS void LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_org uuid:=current_org(); v_fallback uuid; begin if v_org is null or not is_admin() then raise exception 'Only owners and admins can change branch status' using errcode='42501'; end if; if p_active is null then raise exception 'Choose an active status'; end if; perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(v_org::text, 0)); perform 1 from branches where id=p_branch and org_id=v_org for update; if not found then raise exception 'Branch not found' using errcode='42501'; end if; if p_active then update branches set is_active=true where id=p_branch and org_id=v_org; if not exists(select 1 from branches where org_id=v_org and is_default_pickup) then update branches set is_default_pickup=true where id=p_branch and org_id=v_org; end if; else if (select count(*) from branches where org_id=v_org and is_active)>1 then if exists(select 1 from branches where id=p_branch and org_id=v_org and is_default_pickup) then select id into v_fallback from branches where org_id=v_org and id<>p_branch and is_active order by code,id limit 1; update branches set is_default_pickup=false where id=p_branch and org_id=v_org; update branches set is_default_pickup=true where id=v_fallback; end if; update branches set is_active=false where id=p_branch and org_id=v_org; else raise exception 'An organisation must keep at least one active branch'; end if; end if; end $function$

row.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION settle_subscription_payment(p_org_id uuid, p_invoice_id uuid, p_provider_order_id text, p_provider_payment_id text, p_amount_minor bigint, p_provider text DEFAULT 'razorpay'::text) RETURNS jsonb LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_invoice subscription_invoices%rowtype; v_sub org_subscriptions%rowtype; v_plan billing_plans%rowtype; v_end timestamptz; begin select * into v_invoice from subscription_invoices where (p_invoice_id is not null and id = p_invoice_id) or (p_invoice_id is null and p_provider_order_id is not null and provider_order_id = p_provider_order_id) limit 1; if not found then raise exception 'subscription invoice not found'; end if; if p_org_id is not null and v_invoice.org_id <> p_org_id then raise exception 'subscription invoice belongs to another organisation'; end if; -- Replay / double callback: settle exactly once, report success either way. if v_invoice.status = 'paid' then return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'already_paid', true, 'invoice_id', v_invoice.id, 'invoice_no', v_invoice.invoice_no, 'org_id', v_invoice.org_id); end if; -- provider_payment_id is UNIQUE, so a concurrent replay lands here and is ignored. begin insert into subscription_payments (invoice_id, org_id, provider, provider_payment_id, status, amount_minor) values (v_invoice.id, v_invoice.org_id, p_provider, p_provider_payment_id, 'succeeded', p_amount_minor); exception when unique_violation then null; end; update subscription_invoices set status = 'paid', paid_at = coalesce(paid_at, now()) where id = v_invoice.id; select * into v_plan from billing_plans where id = v_invoice.plan_id; if found then v_end := now() + case when v_plan.interval = 'year' then interval '1 year' else interval '1 month' end; select * into v_sub from org_subscriptions where org_id = v_invoice.org_id order by created_at desc limit 1; if not found then insert into org_subscriptions (org_id, plan_id, status, provider, provider_subscription_id, current_period_start, current_period_end, auto_renew) values (v_invoice.org_id, v_plan.id, 'active', p_provider, p_provider_payment_id, now(), v_end, true); else update org_subscriptions set plan_id = v_plan.id, status = 'active', provider = p_provider, provider_subscription_id = p_provider_payment_id, current_period_start = case when current_period_end is null or current_period_end < now() then now() else current_period_start end, current_period_end = greatest(coalesce(current_period_end, now()), now()) + case when v_plan.interval = 'year' then interval '1 year' else interval '1 month' end, auto_renew = true, cancelled_at = null, grace_ends_at = null, reactivated_at = case when status in ('cancelled','expired','suspended') then now() else reactivated_at end where id = v_sub.id; end if; end if; insert into subscription_events (org_id, event_type, payload) values (v_invoice.org_id, 'subscription.payment_succeeded', jsonb_build_object( 'invoice_id', v_invoice.id, 'invoice_no', v_invoice.invoice_no, 'provider_order_id', v_invoice.provider_order_id, 'provider_payment_id', p_provider_payment_id, 'amount_minor', p_amount_minor, 'plan_id', v_invoice.plan_id)); return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'already_paid', false, 'invoice_id', v_invoice.id, 'invoice_no', v_invoice.invoice_no, 'org_id', v_invoice.org_id); end $function$

row.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION start_stock_audit(p_branch uuid, p_title text, p_products uuid[]) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_session uuid; v_org uuid := current_org(); begin if auth.uid() is null or v_org is null or not has_perm('stock_audit') or not can_access_branch(p_branch) then raise exception 'Not authorised to start a stock count' using errcode='42501'; end if; if length(trim(p_title)) not between 2 and 120 or coalesce(array_length(p_products,1),0) not between 1 and 2000 then raise exception 'Enter a title and at least one product'; end if; if exists (select 1 from unnest(p_products) x group by x having count(*) > 1) then raise exception 'Duplicate products in stock count'; end if; if exists (select 1 from unnest(p_products) x left join products p on p.id=x and p.org_id=v_org and p.status='active' where p.id is null) then raise exception 'One or more products are unavailable'; end if; insert into stock_audit_sessions(org_id,branch_id,title,started_by) values(v_org,p_branch,trim(p_title),auth.uid()) returning id into v_session; insert into stock_audit_lines(org_id,session_id,product_id,expected_qty) select v_org,v_session,p.id,coalesce(k.qty,0) from products p left join stock k on k.product_id=p.id and k.branch_id=p_branch where p.id=any(p_products) and p.org_id=v_org; return v_session; end $function$

end if; select * into t from profiles where id = p_id and org_id = c.org_id for update; if not found then raise exception 'Staff member not found'; end if; if t.id = c.id and (p_role is not null or p_deactivated is true) then raise exception 'You cannot change your own role or deactivate yourself'; fresh.def: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION create_organisation(p_name text, p_branch_name text, p_branch_code text) RETURNS uuid LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path TO 'public' AS $function$ declare v_uid uuid := auth.uid(); v_org uuid; v_br uuid; v_name text; v_plan uuid; v_days int; v_end timestamptz; begin if v_uid is null then raise exception 'Sign in first' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if not exists (select 1 from auth.users where id = v_uid and email_confirmed_at is not null) then raise exception 'Confirm your email first'; end if; if exists (select 1 from profiles where id = v_uid and org_id is not null and is_approved) then raise exception 'You already belong to an organisation'; end if; -- First-run bootstrap (no approved member yet), or an allow-listed platform -- operator (legacy table or the platform_users scope). Everything else is -- invitation-only. Keyed on members rather than organisation rows so the demo -- tenant seeded by 0001_foundation cannot lock a fresh install out of setup. if exists (select 1 from profiles where org_id is not null and is_approved) and not exists (select 1 from platform_admins where user_id = v_uid) and not exists (select 1 from platform_users where user_id = v_uid and is_active) then raise exception 'Organisation creation is by invitation only' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if length(trim(coalesce(p_name, ''))) < 2 or length(trim(coalesce(p_branch_name, ''))) < 2 or length(trim(coalesce(p_branch_code, ''))) < 1 then raise exception 'Organisation and branch names are required'; end if; insert into organizations (name) values (trim(p_name)) returning id into v_org; -- Trial: prefer an active public plan, fall back to any public plan, then any -- plan. v_product_ids := v_product_ids || array[v_pid]; end if; -- ── Lab order creation for prescription lens orders ONLY ───────────────────── -- Rule: lab_orders are created only when: -- 1. v_kind = 'order' (actual order, not quotation) -- 2. v_type = 'lens' (lens item) -- 3. v_rx is not null (prescription exists) -- This ensures: -- - Frame-only sales (frame sunglasses without prescription) do NOT create lab jobs -- - Quotations do NOT create lab jobs -- - Product/accessory orders do NOT create lab jobs if v_kind = 'order' and v_type = 'lens' and v_rx is not null then insert into lab_orders (branch_id, sale_id, sale_line_id, customer_id, lens_package_id, lens_desc, lens_details, frame_desc, frame_product_id, rx_code, od_sph, od_cyl, od_axis, od_add, os_sph, os_cyl, os_axis, os_add, pd_far, pd_near, due_date) values (v_branch, v_id, v_lid, v_cust, v_pkg.id, v_desc, v_det, v_fdesc, v_fpid, v_rx->>'rx_code', (v_rx->>'od_sph')::numeric, (v_rx->>'od_cyl')::numeric, (v_rx->>'od_axis')::int, (v_rx->>'od_add')::numeric, (v_rx->>'os_sph')::numeric, (v_rx->>'os_cyl')::numeric, (v_rx->>'os_axis')::int, (v_rx->>'os_add')::numeric, (v_rx->>'pd_far')::numeric, (v_rx->>'pd_near')::numeric, current_date + v_lead); end if; end loop; -- ── Validate lens orders require prescription ──────────────────────────────────── if v_kind = 'order' and v_lab and v_rx is null then raise exception 'Lens orders need a prescription. Add one first.'; end if; -- ── Update sale totals with all GST aggregates ────────────────────────────────── update sales set subtotal = v_sub, -- FIX: discount_total = listed price − what customer pays (always ≥ 0) discount_total = greatest(0, round(v_sub - v_grand, 2)), tax_included = v_cgst_tot + v_sgst_tot + v_igst_tot, grand_total = v_grand, taxable_total = v_taxable_tot, cgst_total = v_cgst_tot, sgst_total = v_sgst_tot, igst_total = v_igst_tot, needs_lab = v_lab, status = case when v_kind = 'quotation' then 'draft' when v_lab then 'lab_pending' else 'ready' end, gst_applied = v_gst, supply_type = v_supply_type, state_of_supply = v_state_of_supply, recipient_gstin = v_recipient_gstin, idempotency_key = v_idem::uuid where id = v_id; -- ── Convert quotation if referencing one ───────────────────────────────────────── if v_qid is not null then update sales set status = 'converted' where id = v_qid; end if; -- ── Insert payment if amount provided ─────────────────────────────────────────── if v_kind = 'order' and v_pay > 0 then insert into payments (sale_id, amount, method, reference) values (v_id, v_pay, coalesce(p->'payment'->>'method','cash'), nullif(p->'payment'->>'reference','')); end if; return jsonb_build_object('id', v_id, 'code', v_code); end $function$
